title: Foundation
blurb: Absolute-beginner track: basic data structures and algorithms with visualizers, short summaries, and further reading.

steps.title: Arrays: indexed storage
steps.summary: Arrays store items contiguously for O(1) indexed access. Inserting or deleting in the middle shifts all later items, costing O(n).

steps.title: Two Sum
steps.summary: First hashing pattern: trade one pass plus a lookup table for the naive pair check.

steps.title: Contains Duplicate
steps.summary: Same set-membership idea as Two Sum, reduced to a yes/no duplicate check.

steps.title: Valid Anagram
steps.summary: Count characters with a frequency map, then compare the counts.

steps.title: Majority Element
steps.summary: Boyer-Moore voting: cancel different pairs and the survivor is the majority.

steps.title: Foundation check
steps.summary: Mixed beginner questions across the structures above.

steps.title: Sorting basics
steps.summary: Sorting arranges data so binary search and two-pointer scans work. Watch how many comparisons each method needs.

steps.title: Merge Sorted Array
steps.summary: Fill from the back so the larger tail value lands straight in its final slot.

steps.title: Binary search step-through
steps.summary: On sorted data, halving the search range each step finds any item in O(log n).

steps.title: Binary Search
steps.summary: Classic halving invariant on a sorted array: test midpoint, discard half in O(log n).

steps.title: Search Insert Position
steps.summary: Binary search for the first index whose value is not smaller than the target.

steps.title: Valid Palindrome
steps.summary: Converging two pointers: compare the ends and walk inward.

steps.title: Move Zeroes
steps.summary: Two pointers in-place: slow write pointer tracks zeros while fast pointer scans.

steps.title: Reverse String
steps.summary: Swap characters from both ends until the pointers cross.

steps.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
steps.summary: Variable sliding window: stretch the right edge, shrink from the left on duplicates.

steps.title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
steps.summary: Window sum that shrinks from the left whenever the target is met.

steps.title: Singly linked list
steps.summary: Nodes linked by pointers: O(1) inserts at a known spot, O(n) access by index.

steps.title: Reverse Linked List
steps.summary: Rewire each node's pointer to its predecessor in one pass.

steps.title: Linked List Cycle
steps.summary: Fast-slow pointer chase: detect cycles in O(n) time and O(1) space.

steps.title: Middle of the Linked List
steps.summary: Slow and fast pointers; the slow one lands on the middle when fast ends.

steps.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
steps.summary: Iterative splice with a dummy head, always attaching the smaller current node.

steps.title: LIFO stack
steps.summary: Last-in first-out: pushes and pops cost O(1) and power bracket matching and undo histories.

steps.title: Valid Parentheses
steps.summary: Push opening brackets, match closers off the top of the stack.

steps.title: Next Greater Entry
steps.summary: Monotonic stack over the larger array, keyed by value, answers each subset query.

steps.title: FIFO queue
steps.summary: First-in first-out: enqueue at the back, dequeue at the front, the base of BFS.

steps.title: Implement Queue using Stacks
steps.summary: Two stacks: push into one, shift everything to the other when a pop needs the front.

steps.title: Hash map buckets
steps.summary: Keys hash to buckets for average O(1) put and get; collisions chain inside a bucket.

steps.title: First Unique Character in a String
steps.summary: Count characters, then rescan in order for the first count of one.

steps.title: Tree traversals
steps.summary: Inorder, preorder, and postorder each visit every node once; order decides what problems they fit.

steps.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
steps.summary: Postorder depth: one plus the deeper of the two child depths.

steps.title: Same Tree
steps.summary: Simultaneous recursive walk: structural and value equality across two trees.

steps.title: Invert Binary Tree
steps.summary: Swap each node's children, then recurse into both subtrees.

steps.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
steps.summary: Postorder heights: the best left-plus-right sum anywhere in the tree is the diameter.

steps.title: Binary search tree
steps.summary: Left subtree smaller, right subtree larger: search, insert, and delete follow the ordering.

steps.title: Ancestor Query in a Search Tree
steps.summary: Walk down from the root: the first node sitting between both values is the answer.

steps.title: Binary heap
steps.summary: A complete tree kept in array form: the root holds the min or max, sift to repair.

steps.title: Last Stone Weight
steps.summary: Max-heap: smash the two heaviest stones and push the difference back.

steps.title: Graph traversal
steps.summary: BFS explores by distance, DFS by depth; both mark nodes so nothing is revisited.

steps.title: Find if Path Exists in Graph
steps.summary: Build adjacency lists and BFS from the source until the destination appears.

steps.title: Flood Fill
steps.summary: DFS or BFS from the seed pixel, recolouring connected cells of the same colour.

steps.title: Recursion tree
steps.summary: Draw every call as a node to see the branching that sets the time complexity.

steps.title: Climbing Stairs
steps.summary: Each step count is the sum of the two previous counts; iterate with two variables.

steps.title: Fibonacci Number
steps.summary: Rolling two-value DP, or fast doubling when n grows large.

steps.title: Trees & BST check
steps.summary: Traversals, BST ordering, and height-based recursions.

steps.title: CS fundamentals screen
steps.summary: OS, DBMS, networks, and memory questions asked in service rounds.
